segments.JHN.21.4-6: Jesus tells the disciples where to cast the net
segments.JHN.21.7-9: Peter jumps into the sea when he knows it is Jesus
segments.JHN.21.10-11: Peter pulls the net with 153 large fish ashore
segments.JHN.21.12-14: Jesus gives the disciples breakfast of bread and fish
segments.JHN.21.15-16: Jesus asks Peter twice if he loves him
segments.JHN.21.17-18: Jesus asks a third time and tells of Peter’s death
segments.JHN.21.19-19: Jesus tells Peter to follow him
segments.JHN.21.20-21: Peter asks Jesus what will happen to the other disciple
segments.JHN.21.24-25: The writer’s testimony is true; Jesus did much more
